341-4659-5224-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {1} due to Umori, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2137-4642-6965.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
2137-4642-6965.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

3817-3991-6495.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 3.
3817-3991-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

222-527-1879-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1879-6495.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
222-527-1879-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1011-2728-4153-5686.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-4153-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-4153-5686.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 4.

851-3129-4826-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1170-1636-7528-7875.notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures to cast Awaken the Ages using convoke without paying mana.
1170-1636-7528-7875.description:
Cast Awaken the Ages using Party Thrasher's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Strife Scholar.
When Strife Scholar enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-5982-7296.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5982-7296.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Ancient Gold Dragon, triggering Breath of Fury and Ancient Gold Dragon.
Resolve the Ancient Gold Dragon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

997-1263-4871-6026.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

413-2452-3249-5173.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
When Shambling Ghast enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3711-4222-4474.description:
Activate Moonfolk Puzzlemaker by tapping it, adding {U}.
Moonfolk Puzzlemaker triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Moonfolk Puzzlemaker.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3644-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Young Wolf
When Young Wolf dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Young Wolf
When Young Wolf dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Young Wolf enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
3644-5686-6972.notes: If Young Wolf starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1123-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Resolve both Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
1123-6798-6972.notes: If Flayer of the Hatebound starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

662-933-2388-6587.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
662-933-2388-6587.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Ultimecia, Time Sorceress to become an artifact.
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

4369-7362.description:
Declare Casey as an attacker, triggering its first ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Casey's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
4369-7362.notes: The combo can be started using another method to either deal damage with a red source or place a +1/+1 counter on a creature.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1636-3859-6972.notablePrerequisites: You are able to pay to cast Cavern Harpy using any combination of mana-producing creatures and/or creatures that can reduce its cost using convoke.
1636-3859-6972.description:
Cast Cavern Harpy by paying its mana cost reduced by the number of creatures you can tap while casting it.
When Cavern Harpy enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Cavern Harpy trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-3859-6972.notes: If you control mana-producing creatures, you can tap those creatures for mana instead of tapping them using the convoke ability.

1479-2841-6158-6517.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Blighted Woodland.
1479-2841-6158-6517.description:
Fetch a land using Blighted Woodland.
When the fetched land enters, Dragonback Assault and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

893-4853-6797.description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Myr.
When the Myr dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Myr Turbine.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

147-2511-3047.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Feign Death, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Feign Death.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 5.

1170-1329-1492-2079.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-2079.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Welding Jar from your graveyard.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2173-2438-5220-6794.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1447-2719-6882.description:
Cast Angel of Glory's Rise by paying {5}{W}{W}.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Cartel Aristocrat by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces
Resolve the Angel of Glory's Rise trigger, exiling all Zombies, and then returning all Humans from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Choose to have Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enter the battlefield as a copy of Angel of Glory's Rise.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

586-3168-3967-5258-5618.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

222-2060-5256-6701.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
Szarel has power 4 or greater or you have another creature card in your graveyard.
222-2060-5256-6701.description:
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and up to one other creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, and the other creature returned in step 1, if applicable.
When Slimefoot and Squee and up to one other creature are sacrificed, Szarel triggers that many times, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler for each trigger.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.
222-2060-5256-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

372-1090-1734.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-1090-1734.notablePrerequisites: Restoration Angel exiled by Fiend Hunter
372-1090-1734.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Fiend Hunter and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Restoration Angel from exile to the battlefield.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Fiend Hunter to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Fiend Hunter and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Restoration Angel.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Fiend Hunter and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

710-2843-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Danitha, adding one mana of any color.
When Danitha dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

813-2061-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Warp each turn.
813-2061-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages.
When the Scholar of the Ages token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

190-389-3778-6124.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, however you cannot lose the game due to Herald of Eternal Dawn.
Cast Austere Command by paying its mana cost, destroying all enchantments.
When each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, they each trigger, causing each opponent to lose the game.

5149-5200-5821.easyPrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Sword of the Paruns.
5149-5200-5821.notablePrerequisites:
Fyndhorn Elder does not have summoning sickness.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Fyndhorn Elder
5149-5200-5821.description:
Activate Fyndhorn Elder by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {1}, untapping Fyndhorn Elder.
Repeat.
5149-5200-5821.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

864-1312-1879-2034-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Doomed Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing it.
When Doomed Necromancer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Doomed Necromancer ability, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Doomed Necromancer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Doomed Necromancer by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

262-859-4716.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Lurking Roper.
262-859-4716.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper's second ability triggers four times.
Resolve the first Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

345-414-4613.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
345-414-4613.description:
Activate a creature using Grist's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token and mill a card, and then put a loyalty counter on the creature and repeat the process if the card was an Insect.
The Insect enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic, causing it to have Grist's abilities.
Repeat from step 1 using the Insect token instead.

618-3492-3609.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Coretapper with haste.
Activate the token Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate the token Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

152-1766-1912-4772.description:
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {5}, creating two token copies of Thran Dynamo.
Activate the token Thran Dynamos by tapping them, adding six {C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1872-3003-5220-5243.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
The Reality Chip attached to another creature you control.
1872-3003-5220-5243.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Composite Golem dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Composite Golem on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Composite Golem from the top of your library by paying at most {4}.
Repeat.

1030-3433-3525-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Othelm.
Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
1030-3433-3525-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hornet Queen, adding {1}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Hornet Queen from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Hornet Queen enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Insect tokens, adding {1}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Othelm.
Repeat.

3750-5039.notablePrerequisites:
The Reaver Cleaver attached to a creature with power five or greater that can attack this turn.
An opponent is unable to block the creature with The Reaver Cleaver attached.
3750-5039.description:
Deal combat damage to a player with the creature that has The Reaver Cleaver attached.
The creature triggers, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

1090-2034-2732.description:
Cast Restoration Angel by paying {3}{W}.
Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, triggering its ability, targeting Prowling Geistcatcher.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Restoration Angel, adding {C}{C}.
Prowling Geistcatcher triggers, exiling Restoration Angel from your graveyard.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger from 2, blinking Prowling Geistcatcher.
Prowling Geistcatcher leaves the battlefield, returning Restoration Angel from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: with a kick counter on it

249-1173-4591.description:
Declare Zethi as an attacker.
Zethi triggers, copying all cards you own in exile with kick counters on them and allowing you to cast the copies.
Cast the Final Fortune copy by paying {R}{R}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and lose the game at the end of the extra turn.
At the beginning of each extra turn's end step, Final Fortune triggers, however you cannot lose the game due to Platinum Angel.
Repeat each turn.

678-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
678-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
